decision.detail: bge-large-en-v1.5 chosen by the project owner. gte-large and bge-base-en-v1.5 were stopped before their runs (not compared). e5-large-v2 was compared paired against bge-large (results/dense/reports/vsbest): statistically tied (dev macro Recall@50 +0.015 [-0.002, 0.032], nDCG@10 +0.005 [-0.008, 0.019]; train nDCG@10 -0.005 [-0.022, 0.012]), so the owner's choice stands. BGE-M3 on clean text is lower on both dev macro metrics.

reembed.basis: 95% bootstrap intervals of the dev macro values do not overlap (winner lower bound above cmp_v1 upper bound)
